note: The realization choices of the provisional realization A01-R2, the goal version (docs/audits/conformance/stage-b/provisional-realizations.json), named by it and read ONLY where A01's authorization record has that realization tried. A01-R2 is a variant of A01-R1, so its kept items keep A01-R1's item ids under its own contract, and their lines are named c:provisional:A01-R2:A01-R1-...; these entries are A01-R1's file's, re-pointed to A01-R2, with three differences: (1) no noun for the possession game's target at the axis-start end (c:restated:GF2:GF2-03.e::S3) - the game form's entry for it is WITHDRAWN instead - because in the goal version that region yields with the reference pointing to it (ruling C63) and the goal stands in its place, so the line is not open; (2) the three build-out restart stand-ins name the bound of his reply filed 26 October 2026, item 8 ("This flexibility should operate within the authorized deep starting environment, rather than permit arbitrary locations anywhere on the field.") in place of the post-regain area, which the goal version does not hold (A01-R1-T4-4 withdrawn, A01-R2-T4-5 added); (3) nothing else. Every stand-in's words are DRAFT coach wording; A01-R2 is listed and not tried until his open decisions (D-GOAL-SUITABILITY, D-PENALTY-AREA), so none of them is said to a coach yet.

choices.because: Not the possession game's to choose in this activity: in the goal version the region at the axis-start end (GF2-03.e) yields together with the objective reference pointing to it (GF2-08.f, ruling C63), and the goal (A01-R2-O1-1) is the pressing team's target in its place - his reply filed 25 October 2026, item 3, "I approve a goalkeeper-protected physical goal as an authorized alternative to the pressing team's 5 m target zone within the Goalkeeper Build-Out context." Left in, the game form's choice of a noun for that region would be a choice for a line that is not open, and realization would refuse it.

The building team's target is a zone, as in A01-R1: in the goal version the building role holds the same end in both blocks (the end exchange, A01-R2-B10-1), so its target is the region at the axis-end end in both, beginning at the pressure reference (A01-R1-S5-2, kept) - his reply filed 26 October 2026, item 1: "Building team: Controlled progression beyond the marked line during an active goalkeeper-initiated build-out." and "The game form's existing line-or-zone progression structure, together with Goalkeeper Build-Out's approved scoring knowledge, should continue to govern the building team." Zone is one of the two nouns the possession game permits (GF2-03.b). Replaces the possession game's entry (a line), for this activity only.

The primary event is the building team's, as in A01-R1: entry into its target zone beyond the marked line, one of the kinds Goalkeeper Build-Out approves (RPC-001-08.a), his reply filed 26 October 2026, item 1: "Building team: Controlled progression beyond the marked line during an active goalkeeper-initiated build-out." The pressing team scores by its own event, a goal (A01-R2-B9-1, row B9), not by this one. Replaces the possession game's line_crossed, which a zone would contradict, for this activity only.
